What is the difference between TCP and UDP?
assistant

TCP is connection based. It checks that every packet arrives, puts the packets in order, and sends a packet again if it is lost. This makes it reliable but slower. UDP has no connection. It sends packets and does not check if they arrive. This makes it fast, but some packets can be lost. Web pages and email use TCP. Video calls and online games often use UDP.

Explain what a Kubernetes Deployment does.
assistant

A Kubernetes Deployment describes the pods that you want to run. You write how many copies you need and which container image to use. Kubernetes then makes the real state equal to this description. If a pod stops, the Deployment starts a new one. If you change the image, the Deployment replaces the old pods with new pods step by step.

assistant
Yes. Set the number of replicas to 0. Kubernetes stops all the pods of the Deployment. The Service stays, but it has no pod behind it, so a request fails until a pod starts again.

What is a KV cache in an LLM?
assistant

A KV cache stores the key and value tensors that the model made for the tokens it has already read. When the model writes the next token, it does not need to compute these tensors again. This makes the generation much faster. The cost is memory: the cache grows with the length of the text and with the number of requests that run at the same time.
